variants.prompt:

Create one polished wide image of TWO equally sized vertical character cards side by side, with the same stone frame around each. Plain very dark warm neutral backdrop outside and inside the frames, no environment or scenery. Characters occupy almost all card interiors, framed from head/crown down to around the knees, with large readable faces and torso materials. Left: the red-haired gold-and-cobalt armored male commander with his signature broad curved sword held down, stance calm and grounded. Right: the blond sun-crowned gold-white-violet armored adult female lancer with the long spear held diagonally. Keep both recognizable via hair color/style, crown, costume color blocking and weapon type. Simplify tiny gold trims into larger functional armor plates; show thickness, layered construction, shadow at contacts, fabric weight. Fit characters behind the frame; frames stay straight front-facing and same thickness. No new props, scenery, particles, mist, flares, text, numbers, badges, card stats or watermarks.
Important requested facial/figure redesign: male is about 40-45, handsome in a seasoned commanding way, short broad chin, definite brow and cheek planes, strong shoulder-neck connection, proportionate robust hands and torso; NOT pointed elongated face, narrow teen jaw, porcelain idol face or wispy fashion-model physique. Keep existing short beard/stubble modest, not a huge beard or caricature brute. Female remains distinctly beautiful and adult, poised and strong, with structurally modeled face, natural neck/shoulders and convincing anatomy; NOT doll-like, childlike, or fragile. Both characters must be rendered in exactly the SAME medium for this option. Do not preserve the old thin shiny anime rendering.
This is one of four intentionally different styles. Use the following option's medium strongly, not a generic halfway compromise: A — HEROIC HAND-PAINTED FANTASY CARD ILLUSTRATION. Bold hand-painted forms, broad expressive gouache/digital brush masses, deliberately simplified heroic proportions and readable silhouettes, substantial arms/shoulders and articulated face planes, warm ochre gold and cool cobalt with concentrated saturated accents. Large soft reflected-light areas and selective crisp edges. Sculpt volume using rich shadow families and decisive planes, not outlines and sparkle. Harmonize painterly stone and metal surfaces. Armor looks substantial and brushed rather than glossy; skin has lively warm/cool painted planes. Energetic, charismatic, premium fantasy boardgame illustration, clearly painted, NOT photorealism, NOT flat anime, NOT toy plastic.
